purpose: Use Hermes as a bounded supervisor over MEDIA REFINERY while local vision handles bulk semantic annotation.

hermes_supervisor.recommended_provider: ChatGPT/Codex OAuth or another strong configured Hermes provider

bulk_visual_semantics.reason: Small enough for continuous local throughput while retaining vision, OCR and spatial semantics.
bulk_visual_semantics.note: Bulk worker talks directly to Ollama and sets num_ctx=65536 per request.

supervisor.preferred: strong Hermes tool model via configured provider; ChatGPT/Codex OAuth avoids a separate OpenAI API key when available
supervisor.law: Do not spend supervisor inference on every image.

similarity_embedding_next.use: semantic image retrieval / nearest-neighbor family discovery
similarity_embedding_next.law: Embedding similarity is a retrieval signal, not lineage or composition truth.

structural_embedding_optional.use: morphology/structure-sensitive similarity when SigLIP2 + quantitative metrics prove insufficient.

laws: ORGANIZATION IS AN INDEX/VIEW BEFORE IT IS A FILESYSTEM MOVE.
LOCAL BULK MODEL MAY ONLY RETURN SEMANTIC OVERLAYS.
LOW-CONFIDENCE OR INVALID OVERLAYS DO NOT ENTER CANONICAL MEMORY.
HERMES HANDLES EXCEPTIONS; IT DOES NOT DUPLICATE DETERMINISTIC PIPELINE WORK.
NO RENDERING OR TRANSLATE IN THE CURATION LOOP.
NO CRON UNTIL A SMALL BOUNDED RUN COMPLETES CLEANLY.

local_surfaces.source_media: never copied to repo by default

success: all attempted batches either accepted or explicitly held
recipe queue changes only after accepted overlay evidence
